governingFoundations.notes: Primitive decisions are downstream from these foundations.

foundationInputs.notes: Inputs come from system roles, not raw values.

roles.notes: Roles are stable across components, patterns, templates, and agents.

states.notes: State coverage must stay visible in examples and implementation.

apiOutputs.notes: The primitive returns semantic implementation hooks.

shared.notes: Consumes semantic tokens, never raw values.
State semantics come from system foundations.
Same naming and behavior across implementation targets.

Typography.notes: Display, titles, and numerals use Edenred Black; body, captions, subtitles, and code use Ubuntu.

Typography.contract: display / heading / numeral / label / paragraph / caption / code
Typography.notes: Roles map to semantic HTML and product copy hierarchy.
Uses the reference Voice scale with responsive hierarchy.

Spacing.notes: All gaps, padding, margins, and grouping derive from the reference Frame scale.
Density adjusts the token mapping, not one-off component CSS.

Iconography.notes: No emoji or arbitrary text labels as icon replacements.
Every icon has a job and an accessible label rule.
